absent: Semantics and status encoding of the secure monitor call channel and layout of the module argument block.
Layout of the trust domain control structure, meaning of its root page, and value or lifecycle of the global key identifier.
Width and source of the CPU physical address bit count and handling of identifiers exceeding available bits.
State machine and retry protocol for cache writeback resume versus fresh start and for page writeback completion.
Locking, ownership and concurrency rules for the memory block list and the region descriptor collection.
Allocation, population and release protocol for the region descriptor storage and selection of target descriptors.
Meaning and use of page types PT_NDA and PT_RSVD and the version field shift.
Error handling and side effects of the writeback leaves beyond the returned status word.

findings.text: Helper tdh_phymem_cache_wb accepts a resume flag and forwards it through the module argument channel to the cache writeback leaf, then returns the leaf status word. True selects continued operation while false selects fresh start.

Helper tdh_phymem_page_wbinvd_tdr derives a key protected address from the global key identifier and the frame backing the domain root page, places it in the request channel, and invokes the physical memory page writeback leaf, returning its status.

Helper tdh_phymem_page_wbinvd_hkid accepts a key identifier plus frame number, combines them into a key protected address in the request channel, and invokes the same physical memory page writeback leaf, returning its status.

Key protected addresses place the key identifier immediately above the implemented physical address width, combining the frame derived base with the identifier shifted by the CPU physical address bit count.

Descriptor tdmr_reserved_area is packed and holds offset followed by size, each a 64 bit unsigned value, with no padding.

Descriptor tdmr_info is packed and aligned to 512 bytes. It holds base and size, then pamt_1g_base with pamt_1g_size, pamt_2m_base with pamt_2m_size, and pamt_4k_base with pamt_4k_size, each a 64 bit unsigned value, followed by a variable length tail of reserved area descriptors.
Node tdx_memblock provides list linkage through list and records frame range start_pfn to end_pfn plus integer nid for NUMA placement.
Collection tdmr_info_list holds opaque storage pointer tdmrs, in use count nr_consumed_tdmrs, per entry byte size tdmr_sz, and capacity max_tdmrs, where the latter two guide lookup and release.

The length of the reserved area tail is not fixed in the type but is determined at runtime by a global metadata field for maximum reserved entries per region, and both the descriptor and its address array require 512 byte alignment.
Header employs a conventional include guard macro to prevent multiple inclusion.
External dependency owned by another dossier, required for address construction.
